sources.title: PCG rescues 37 people from distressed vessel in Tawi-Tawi
PCG rescues 37 people aboard a distressed vessel in Tawi-Tawi

title: Wooden boat M/L Alim loses its engine off Panglima Sugala; all 37 aboard towed to Bongao
summary: The wooden-hulled M/L Alim, travelling from Tandubas to Bongao with 37 people aboard, 10 of them crew, developed engine trouble off Panglima Sugala, Tawi-Tawi, on the afternoon of Monday, 26 October 2026. Coast Guard Sub-Station Panglima Sugala answered its distress call and towed the boat to the Port of Bongao, where it arrived early that evening with everyone aboard safe.
